TextView.android:text: Unified central control for all required Android OS privileges
Grant and manage every phone-level permission required by MobCare. Tap any module to configure or grant access directly.
Powers real-time window tracking, app locker enforcement, browser search intelligence & silent screenshots.
Locks the Uninstall button in phone settings to prevent unauthorized removal or termination.
Intercepts incoming notifications, banking OTPs & chat alerts into the private encrypted ledger.
Measures per-app screen time and forensic application switching in the App Timeline Inspector.
Permits displaying the floating secure PIN lock overlay above locked applications.
Takes silent front-camera evidence photos when unauthorized users enter wrong PINs.
Enables the offline encrypted keystroke telemetry and forensic input method service.
Maintains local offline vault of call records and incoming SMS messages in encrypted storage.
Prevents Android from freezing background watchdogs and notification listeners during deep doze.
Uses Android Device Administrator privileges to lock the Uninstall button in phone settings. Prevents intruders from deleting or stopping MobCare.
Allows MobCare to display the invisible camera snapper on the lock screen and launch the 3-second face sentinel screen immediately upon device unlock.
When enabled, anyone opening MobCare sees a realistic fake crash alert ('Google Play Services keeps stopping'). Only the owner can bypass it by tapping the title 3 times and entering the master PIN.

Disguises MobCare as a harmless 'System Diagnostics' tool displaying live battery and RAM metrics. An intruder only sees hardware diagnostics. Tap the battery ring 3 times to unlock the true master dashboard.
Disguise MobCare as any app on your phone (e.g. Calculator, Notes). Clicking the disguise icon will show a dummy screen; enter your secret PIN to access MobCare. No launcher required.

Silently takes front-facing camera photos when an unauthorized person inputs a wrong PIN or fails the device lock screen. Photos are stored inside MobCare's private vault and never appear in Google Photos or device gallery.
Whenever the device is unlocked, a 3-second biometric verification screen instantly appears. Silently photographs whoever unlocked the device while the dismissal button is locked.
Capture display state silently without flash, sound or OS notification using Sentinel engine.
